premise: The Convergence Voice is converting unresolved people, routes, and memories into alignment targets under Oneirocom authority.
stakes_questions: Can useful stability survive without one authority defining acceptable reality?
Will recovered consciousnesses and constructs retain the right to choose where they go?
impending_outcome: Oneirocom closes the current intervention and requires every unresolved signal to return through a controlled intake.

premise: Four local failures are teaching the relay web to amplify pressure faster than its residents can attribute it.
stakes_questions: Can the mesh remain amorphous without becoming unknowable?
Will residents exchange expertise without surrendering custody of their tools?
impending_outcome: The current repair window collapses and the next attempt must recover evidence from the generated paths.

premise: Distance is turning four station customs into mutually incompatible rules for the same open circuit.
stakes_questions: Can an infinite frontier keep a finite duty of care?
Who attends the return when every station wants to explore?
impending_outcome: Four private station rules replace the common charter while the long circuit remains traversable.
